pages.title: Next Stop
pages.text: Lay out the first railway site; a modest track reward lets you extend it.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Begin at a native station and use Ponder for bogeys, assembly and controls. This entry checks the three placements, not an already working train.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Select one track and another destination to place a straight, curved or sloped connection. Construct a rail route; offhand materials can pave beneath it.
